title: BPBond 솔로 #057 · 블랙글래머 · Mexican Talavera ceramic · 몸통·팔+다리 체인 결박 · glossy white lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, demure and soft, bright golden-blonde hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic — a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her upper arms are pressed against her sides and bound to her torso with many tight turns of a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, wound around her ribcage and upper arms from just below her bust down to her waist, locked with a heavy iron padlock at her back, her forearms and hands free below the chain. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, outward to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at hip height on its own side, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains. Her legs are pressed together and wound around from her ankles to above her knees with several turns of a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, locked at the front with a heavy iron padlock.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her wrists together above her head, her arms stretched fully straight up, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: Extreme cobalt extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
